extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians working on inter-universal Teichmüller theory / anabelian geometry / advanced number theory
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts the conceptual constraints, structural requirements, and compatibility conditions Mochizuki lists for constructions in inter-universal Teichmüller theory (IUT): local/global isolation, properties of Kummer towers, log/Log maps, symmetrizing isomorphisms, and when/provide why certain diagrams/splittings cannot exist.

rubrics_metrics.name: NoSpl (no splitting of GFmod→ΓGal_mod)
rubrics_metrics.description: The surjection GFmod → ΓGal_mod of profinite groups does not admit a splitting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This non-existence of a splitting may be reformulated as the natural outer action of ΓGal_mod not admitting a lifting to an action free of inner automorphism indeterminacies; inner automorphism indeterminacies are therefore essential and unavoidable in the relevant natural outer actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No lifting of outer action free of inner automorphisms
rubrics_metrics.description: The natural outer action of ΓGal_mod does not admit a lifting to an action of ΓGal_mod that is free of inner automorphism indeterminacies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consequently permutations of prime-strips etc. give rise inevitably to inner automorphism (conjugacy) indeterminacies in isomorphisms between local absolute Galois groups appearing in distinct prime-strips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inner automorphism indeterminacies are essential
rubrics_metrics.description: Inner automorphism (conjugacy) indeterminacies occurring in the natural outer actions are essential and unavoidable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is emphasized a fortiori in multiple contexts (global absolute Galois groups, multiplicative and additive symmetry portions) and explains the need for constructions that do not presuppose canonical embeddings into global Galois groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: NoSyn (no conjugacy-free synchronization of local Gv copies)
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no well-defined synchronization between copies of local absolute Galois groups Gv that is free of inner automorphism (conjugacy) indeterminacies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such a conjugate-free synchronization would be required to construct unit-group data in certain prime-strips; its nonexistence motivates the isolation of local copies of Gv from global groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: LGIsl (local-global isolation requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Treat the copies of the local absolute Galois group Gv not as subgroups of some global absolute Galois group, but rather as coric objects independent of any embedding into a global absolute Galois group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This isolation is fundamental for avoiding unwanted inner automorphism indeterminacies and is used throughout the construction of (Θ±ellNF)-Hodge theaters; it has downstream consequences (e.g., for reconstructing local ring structures one must apply absolute anabelian algorithms locally to Πv rather than to abstract Gv).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prime-strip sections viewpoint (SctNF)
rubrics_metrics.description: Treat various prime-strips in the multiplicative symmetry portion as 'sections' (in a suitable sense) of the finite étale quotient Spec(K) → Spec(Fmod).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This point-of-view is fundamentally incompatible with the prime-decomposition trees of the number fields K, Fmod and again requires LGIsl.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconstruction limitation: ring structure not from abstract Gv
rubrics_metrics.description: The ring structure of the nonarchimedean local field giving rise to Gv cannot be reconstructed from the abstract topological group Gv.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Therefore to reconstruct the ring structures needed (e.g., for the log-link), one must apply absolute anabelian algorithms locally to Πv and regard each coric copy of Gv as a suitable quotient of a coric copy of Πv.

rubrics_metrics.name: N-th power map is not additive (i-a)
rubrics_metrics.description: For N ≥ 2, the N-th power map on O_k (the ring of integers) is not a ring homomorphism; i.e., it is not compatible with the additive structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a basic property influencing how Kummer towers behave: multiplicative N-th power maps disrupt additive structure and hence cannot be treated as ring homomorphisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: N-th power map is Gk-/Π-equivariant (i-b)
rubrics_metrics.description: The N-th power map on O_k is (Π (or Gk))-equivariant and thus may be thought to induce, on étale-like cyclotomes constructed via anabelian algorithms, an isomorphism functorially induced by some a priori indeterminate automorphism of Gk or Π.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because one must treat Gk or Π as abstract topological groups (not as groups of field automorphisms), N-th power maps carry indeterminacies at the level of induced isomorphisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: N-th power maps alter cyclotomic rigidity isomorphisms (i-c)
rubrics_metrics.description: The N-th power map alters cyclotomic rigidity isomorphisms (but not synchronizations between collections of such isomorphisms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: action of N-th power on n-th roots of unity for n prime to N; basepoint shifts between constituent Kummer tower objects are substantive/nontrivial for cyclotomic rigidity isomorphisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: p-adic log yields single unified basepoint for truncated objects (i-d)
rubrics_metrics.description: The p-adic logarithm log_k yields a precise, well-defined — and free of conjugacy or N-th power map indeterminacies — set-theoretic relationship between the basepoint of a constituent Kummer tower object in the domain and its counterpart in the codomain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thus for a single finite (truncated) constituent Kummer object (with its additive structure intact) one gets a single unified basepoint valid simultaneously for domain and codomain of log_k.

rubrics_metrics.name: Log on inverse limits (i-e) only relates inverse-limit basepoint to single constituent basepoint
rubrics_metrics.description: The map Log_k induced on inverse limits of the Kummer tower only yields a relationship between the inverse limit basepoint in the domain and the basepoint associated to a single constituent Kummer tower object in the codomain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Raising to N-th power in domain corresponds to multiplying by N in codomain; basepoint shifts between constituent objects imply substantive effects on cyclotomic rigidity isomorphisms and synchronizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inverse limit bias toward multiplicative structure (ii-a)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Kummer tower inverse limit lim_N is biased toward the multiplicative structure of the rings involved, at the expense of additive structures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This bias makes the inverse limit fundamentally incompatible with the juggling/rotation/permutation of additive and multiplicative structures required by the log-link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonexistence / impracticality of 'hyper-multiplicative' transition maps (ii-b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructing a 'hyper-multiplicative tower' of copies of lim←− O×_k that lifts (relative to Log_k) the multiplicative Kummer tower in the codomain appears unrealistically intractable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formally such transition maps would need to realize x ↦ x^{ {log(x)}^{M-1} } (formal expression) and to relate multiplicative Kummer theories across domain/codomain; no natural approach is conceived.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonexistence of certain equivariant commutative diagrams (iii-a, iii-b)
rubrics_metrics.description: There does not exist a commutative diagram Z --ζ→ lim←− O×_k with equivariant λ: Z → lim←− k making Log_k commute as in the stated diagram; consequently Log_k does not admit factorization through a Gk-equivariant λ into lim←− k.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The proof uses constructing f = 1 + x with x ∈ p^2 · O_k and examining Galois groups of extensions obtained by adjoining N-th roots to reach contradiction via valuation/value-group considerations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ring structure preserved on constituent objects, not on inverse limits (iv-a, iv-b)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ring structure on O_k ∪ {0} (enabling power series for log_k) remains intact for any particular constituent Kummer tower object, but the natural multiplicative structure on the inverse limits (lim_N k, lim_N O_k, lim_N O×_k) does not admit any corresponding additive structure giving a ring compatible with Gk-action and projections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This incompatibility explains why Log_k cannot factor through or create a logarithm power-series structure on the inverse limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nonexistence of splittings for natural projections (iv-c)
rubrics_metrics.description: The various natural Gk-equivariant projections from inverse limits (e.g., lim←− O×_k → O×_k) do not admit splittings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Restricting to roots of unity demonstrates this: a splitting would imply a splitting of Q_p → Q_p / Z_p, which does not exist; hence no natural way relates finite Kummer theory for a single constituent to the profinite Kummer theory from the inverse limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inverse limits do not admit compatible topological field structures (v-a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Neither Ik := lim←−_N k nor IO×_k := lim←−_N O×_k ∪ {0} admits a field structure stabilized by the natural action of Gk whose underlying multiplicative structure is the inverse-limit multiplicative structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Argument uses choice of odd prime l, passage to l-power roots of unity, construction of extensions showing contradictions (finite vs infinite field size). If such a topological field structure existed one could define logarithm power series — but it does not.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fundamental dichotomy: truncated vs profinite Kummer theory (vi-a, vi-b)
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a fundamental dichotomy between (finitely) truncated Kummer theory and profinite Kummer theory: truncated theory admits a single unified basepoint for domain/codomain of log_k, profinite theory does not, forcing independent treatment of domain/codomain Kummer theories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In profinite Kummer theory the absence of a single unified basepoint means sets Ik or IO×_k with their multiplicative structures and Gk-actions must be regarded as independent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indeterminate isomorphism nature of 'copies of Gk' (vi-c)
rubrics_metrics.description: Copies of 'Gk' appearing in Kummer theories should be thought of as abstract topological groups related only via some indeterminate isomorphism Π ∼→ Π; such indeterminacy includes inner automorphisms of Π.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is why one must work with abstract topological groups (not groups of ring/field automorphisms) in the context of log- and Θ-links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Symmetrizing isomorphisms: F^3± vs F^2_l behavior (Example 3.8.4 (i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Symmetrizing isomorphisms arising from F^3±-symmetries are free of inner automorphism indeterminacies and give conjugate synchronizations, whereas those from the F^2_l-symmetries necessarily involve inner automorphism indeterminacies (conjugacy).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If one forgets conjugate synchronization and looks only at arbitrary indeterminate isomorphisms, the two kinds of symmetrizing isomorphisms coincide; but for IUT constructions the distinction is crucial.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compatibility via F^3± transport and role of truncatibility (ii)
rubrics_metrics.description: Compatibility between F^3±-symmetrizing isomorphisms (without conjugacy indeterminacies) and the truncated Kummer theories (i-a) follows by transport of structure via F^3± and is necessary to define the diagonal local data used to construct the local unit group portion of the Θ-link gluing data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This local unit-group portion must be independent of evaluation labels t ∈ F_l internally; truncatibility of the Kummer theory is fundamental to constructing containers and to represent the Θ-pilot externally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Label-by-label synchronization requirement (iii)
rubrics_metrics.description: To synchronize conjugacy indeterminacies in the domain/codomain of the log-link one must synchronize locally 'label by label' for the various labels t ∈ F_l; a single global indeterminate isomorphism is not sufficient.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This label-by-label approach is made possible only because truncated Kummer theory provides canonical single unified basepoints at each evaluation label.

rubrics_metrics.name: i-c Kummer/Galois evaluation independence and only Fmod external diagonal (iv, iv-d)
rubrics_metrics.description: Kummer theories/Galois evaluation operations associated to κ-coric rational functions (i-c) involve pseudo-monoids that must be treated independently and are related only up to indeterminacies coming from indeterminate isomorphisms between corresponding Galois groups; as a result the only diagonal number field externally well-defined is Fmod.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compatibility/synchronization of Iord± indeterminacies can be achieved relative to F^2_l-symmetry or via local/global comparisons, but not via the log-link itself because the relevant Frobenius-like monoids are not set-theoretically related by the log-link.

rubrics_metrics.name: For theta-function type Kummer theory (i-b), a single unified basepoint is forced but conjugacy indeterminacy unacceptable (v)
rubrics_metrics.description: To compare Kummer/Galois evaluation at different theta-values via F^3±-symmetry one would need a single unified set-theoretic basepoint invariant under F^3±; however in profinite situations such a basepoint exists only up to conjugacy, which would make theta values/coefficient cyclotomes well-defined only up to (Z[·]×)-powers — unacceptable for IUT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thus one needs truncated-type objects/invariants to avoid such conjugacy indeterminacies when working with theta-function related Kummer theory.
